Q: "distribution was not found and is required by the application" when using pyinstaller with setuptools A:

That may not help anybody, but my repo was using pyinstaller from my main python distribution, until I installed pyinstaller in my venv. Then I got:

where pyinstaller
C:\dev\code\t3-revue\.venv\small\Scripts\pyinstaller.exe
C:\Users\xxx\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311\Scripts\pyinstaller.exe

When it used the one from my venv, from which I was issuing the command, it worked:

$ pwd
/c/dev/code/t3-revue
$ cls; pyinstaller config/installer/eyebrain.spec -y
-> no error

Hope that helps.

Q: KeyError: 'getpwuid(): uid not found: 381206' A:

The error happens in my python ver 3.5 as well in Linux. In my case, once a person leaves the company, his/her UID is replaced with a number and pwd.getpwuid(st.st_uid) fails with the error.

I replaced it with sh.stat('-c', '%U', <path>).stdout.decode('utf-8').strip(), which returns UNKNOWN.

Q: xml: uncapturable attribute A:

Short answer

Instead of -e '*[@src]', use -e 'img/@src', or -e '//@src'.

Long answer

I would advice you to prettify the HTML-source, save it locally and examine it thoroughly to create your own query with unique identifiers:

$ xidel -s "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trigonometric_identities" -e . \
  --output-node-format=html --output-node-indent > List_of_trigonometric_identities.htm

$ xidel -s "List_of_trigonometric_identities.htm" \
  -e '//td[@class="sidebar-image"]/span/a/img/@src'
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/250px-Trig_Functions.svg.png

You may have noticed there's also a 500px version of that image in the same <img> element node:

$ xidel -s "List_of_trigonometric_identities.htm" \
  -e '//td[@class="sidebar-image"]/span/a/img/@srcset'
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/500px-Trig_Functions.svg.png 2x

$ xidel -s "List_of_trigonometric_identities.htm" \
  -e '//td[@class="sidebar-image"]/span/a/img/tokenize(@srcset)[1]'
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/500px-Trig_Functions.svg.png

If you want the highest resolution PNG-image, or the original SVG-file, you could go one step further by "clicking" on the image-link to "/wiki/File:Trig_Functions.svg":

$ xidel -s "List_of_trigonometric_identities.htm" \
  -e '//td[@class="sidebar-image"]/span/a/@href'
/wiki/File:Trig_Functions.svg

$ xidel -s "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trigonometric_identities" \
  -f '//td[@class="sidebar-image"]/span/a/@href' -e . \
  --output-node-format=html --output-node-indent > Trig_Functions.svg.htm

$ xidel -s "Trig_Functions.svg.htm" -e '//div[@class="fullImageLink"]/a/@href'
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg

$ xidel -s "Trig_Functions.svg.htm" -e '//div[@class="fullImageLink"]/div/span/a/@href'
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/250px-Trig_Functions.svg.png
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/500px-Trig_Functions.svg.png
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/960px-Trig_Functions.svg.png
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/1280px-Trig_Functions.svg.png
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/3840px-Trig_Functions.svg.png

$ xidel -s "Trig_Functions.svg.htm" \
  -e '//div[@class="fullImageLink"]/div/span/a[last()]/@href'
//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/3840px-Trig_Functions.svg.png

Finally to actually download the image (to the current dir):

$ xidel "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trigonometric_identities" \
  -f '//td[@class="sidebar-image"]/span/a/@href' \
  -f '//div[@class="fullImageLink"]/div/span/a[last()]/@href' \
  --download .
Retrieving (GET): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trigonometric_identities
Processing: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trigonometric_identities
Retrieving (): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Trig_Functions.svg
Processing: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Trig_Functions.svg
Retrieving (): https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/48/Trig_Functions.svg/3840px-Trig_Functions.svg.png
Save as: ./Trig_Functions.svg.png
